test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'GASTRIC' is coded as 7119201833 and 'FREEDOM' is coded as 618224413. How will 'BOARDING' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• Code for consonants = positional value of the consonants
 
• Code for vowels:

A = 1; E = 2; I = 3; O = 4; U = 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eab7b1d16d7343bf4b81e0605086da24c70b9a327708186337b705592df19cf7.png] 

'GASTRIC' is coded as 7119201833

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81be647d61ea89fdcb21268079a8fc6ca4897c8176fdc559f6ff7895bf570bad.png] 

And,

'FREEDOM' is coded as 618224413

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eabc69b7e2ff1c5155aa0a45e14cfdbf45fbc1583ddc68c5fdd9f136b86e5a5.png] 

Similarly,

BOARDING = ?

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/812d8e34ca2e5c89f81a878720d17be4fe3ab259d541ad0527dd3e8afab2ecb4.png] 

Hence, 'BOARDING' is coded as "**2411843147**".
